name: Priya Sharma
bio:
Priya's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, with a childhood spent tinkering with her grandfather's vintage motorcycle. This early fascination led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in precision manufacturing. After graduating, she honed her skills at a local engineering firm before making the leap to Rexal FMI Racing five years ago. 

Priya is meticulous in her work, viewing each component as a critical piece of a larger, high-stakes puzzle. Her ability to rapidly diagnose and rectify mechanical issues, often under immense pressure, has earned her the respect of her colleagues. What sets Priya apart is her ability to adapt and innovate, finding unconventional solutions to complex challenges.

physical.hairStyle: Long, thick hair usually tied back in a practical braid.
physical.description: Priya is of average height with a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn set of precision calipers.
Has a habit of humming classical Indian ragas while working on intricate parts.
Keeps a small potted tulsi plant on her workbench for good luck.
